candidate.answerReason: The box has volume 1200 cubic centimeters. Eight disjoint cubes remove 216 cubic centimeters, which is 18% of the original volume.

methods.label: Compare removed and original volumes
methods.explanation:
We need the removed volume as a fraction of the original volume. The original box has volume
\[
15\cdot10\cdot8=1200\text{ cm}^3.
\]
A box has eight corners. Since every box dimension exceeds \(2\cdot3=6\) cm, the cubes cut from different corners do not overlap. Each cube has volume \(3\cdot3\cdot3=27\text{ cm}^3\), so the total volume removed is \(8\cdot27=216\text{ cm}^3\).

The fraction removed is
\[
\frac{216}{1200}=\frac{18}{100}=18\%.
\]
Thus \(\boxed{18\%}\) of the original volume is removed, choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
